comparison.objective: Fit and centre an inside-bolt-circle gasket, then insert four flange bolts.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible gasket placement in a constrained joint followed by repeated bolt insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Gasket flat, centred, released and still; all four bolts upright and seated in their holes.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained gasket positioning and bolt placement, without hammer impact, intentional break-off, or recovery of sacrificial parts.
